cards.text: This happens in the first year of Belshazzar, king of Babylon. Daniel, an exile from Judah (Daniel 1:1-6), has a dream, and visions pass through his mind as he lies on his bed. He writes the dream down, and friend, my dreams are GONE before the oven's even warm.

Daniel says, "In my vision in the night I looked, and suddenly the four winds of heaven were churning up the great sea." Four winds on ONE sea is me when all four oven timers go off at once and I've only got one mustache.

cards.question: The four winds of heaven are churning up the great sea in Daniel's vision. What comes up out of it?
The four great beasts that come up out of the sea all look alike.

cards.text: The first beast is like a lion, and it has the wings of an eagle. A lion that can FLY, friend, when it takes me three tries just to hop over a mixing bowl.

cards.question: Daniel keeps watching the beast that's like a lion. What happens to its eagle wings?
With its wings gone, the lion-like beast is lifted from the ground, made to stand on two feet and given the mind of a ___.

cards.text: Then another beast shows up that looks like a bear, raised up on one of its sides. It has three ribs in its mouth between its teeth, which is my mustache after I taste-test a batch, only mine is crumbs.

cards.question: The bear-like beast has three ribs in its mouth. What is it told to do?

answers.text: Get up and gorge on flesh
Go back down into the sea

cards.text: Next comes a beast like a leopard, with four wings like a bird's on its back. And FOUR heads, when I've got one head and still can't remember where I set the timer.

cards.question: The leopard-like beast is given authority to rule.

cards.text: Then a fourth beast appears, terrifying, dreadful and extremely strong, with large iron teeth. Daniel doesn't even say this one is like an animal, and friend, when HE runs out of comparisons, I'm running out of the bakery.

cards.question: The fourth beast devours and crushes with its iron teeth. What does it do with whatever is left?

answers.text: Leaves it for the other beasts

cards.question: The fourth beast is a lot like the three beasts that came before it.

cards.text: This beast has ten horns, and while Daniel is thinking about them, a little horn comes up among them. He's still counting horns, and here comes ANOTHER one.

cards.question: When the little horn comes up among the ten horns, what happens to three of the first horns?
This little horn has eyes like those of a man and a mouth that speaks words of ___.

cards.text: As Daniel keeps watching, thrones are set in place and the Ancient of Days takes His seat. His clothing is white as snow, the hair of His head is like pure wool, and His throne is flaming with fire, its wheels all ablaze.

cards.question: A river of fire flows out from the presence of the Ancient of Days.
A crowd attends the Ancient of Days. How many attend Him?

cards.text: The court is convened, and the books are opened. I spent years in a junk drawer holding my breath every time that thing opened, and friend, I'd be holding it right now too.

cards.question: Daniel keeps watching because of the arrogant words the little horn is speaking. What happens to the beast that horn belongs to?

answers.text: It's slain and thrown into the fire
It flees back into the great sea
It bows down before the throne

cards.question: The rest of the beasts lose their dominion, but they're allowed to live on for a season and a time.

cards.text: Then Daniel says, "I saw One like the Son of Man coming with the clouds of heaven." He approaches the Ancient of Days and is led into His presence.

cards.question: One like the Son of Man is led into the presence of the Ancient of Days. What kind of kingdom is He given?

answers.text: One that will never be destroyed
One that lasts for a season
One that is shared with the beasts

cards.question: One like the Son of Man is given dominion, glory and kingship, so that the people of every nation and language should ___ Him.

cards.text: And Daniel? He's grieved in his spirit, and the visions alarm him. Friend, I get alarmed when the oven timer goes off and I forgot I even SET it.

cards.question: Daniel is alarmed by everything he's seen. What does he do about it?

answers.text: Asks someone standing there what it means
Calls for the wise men of Babylon

cards.text: One of those standing there gives him the interpretation. The four great beasts are four kings who will arise from the earth.

cards.question: The four kings the four beasts stand for will receive the kingdom and possess it forever.
The ___ of the Most High will receive the kingdom and possess it forever.

cards.text: But Daniel wants to know the true meaning of the fourth beast, the terrifying one that's different from all the others. Now we find out it has bronze claws too, because apparently iron teeth weren't ENOUGH.

He also wants to know about the ten horns and the other horn that came up, the one with eyes and an arrogant mouth, before which three of them fell. And its appearance is more imposing than the others, which is a LOT for a horn Daniel first called little.

cards.question: As Daniel watches, the arrogant horn is waging war. Who is it fighting against?

answers.text: The saints of the Most High
The rest of the ten horns

cards.question: In this war, the horn is prevailing against the saints.

cards.text: But that goes on only until the Ancient of Days arrives and pronounces judgment in favor of the saints of the Most High. UNTIL, friend. Best word in the whole sentence.

cards.question: Once the Ancient of Days judges in favor of the saints, the time comes for them to ___ the kingdom.

cards.text: Then the one standing there explains: the fourth beast is a fourth kingdom, different from all the others, and it will devour the whole earth, trample it down and crush it. The WHOLE earth, friend, and I lose it when somebody steps on ONE cookie box.

cards.question: The fourth beast is a kingdom. What are the ten horns on its head?

answers.text: Ten kings who rise from it

cards.question: After the ten kings, another king rises, different from the earlier ones, and he subdues all ten of them.

cards.text: That king who rises after the ten will speak out against the Most High and oppress His saints, intending to change the appointed times and laws. Friend, I can't even change the clock on my oven, and this guy's going after the APPOINTED times.

cards.question: The saints will be given into the hand of the king who rises after the ten kings. For how long?

answers.text: A time and times and half a time
Seventy years in a foreign land

cards.text: But the court will convene. Friend, that little word BUT is doing some heavy lifting.

cards.question: When the court convenes, what happens to the dominion of the king who spoke against the Most High?

answers.text: It's taken away and destroyed forever
It's handed over to another king
It's extended for one more season

cards.question: Once that king's dominion is destroyed, the sovereignty, dominion and greatness of the kingdoms under all of heaven are given to the saints of the Most High.
Daniel hears that His kingdom will be an everlasting kingdom. What will all rulers do?

answers.text: Go back to their own kingdoms

cards.text: Daniel says, "Thus ends the matter." But his thoughts trouble him greatly, and friend, after a night like that, I bet he didn't hit snooze.

cards.question: Daniel's thoughts trouble him so greatly that his face turns ___.
After all of this, what does Daniel do with the matter?
